verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator (PCIe/OAM cards plus a PyTorch software stack) that users run their own training and inference workloads on. It is not a service that ingests user data, so a vendor training-data opt-out is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product collecting user data for model training, and nothing addresses a data-use policy for the cloud access mentioned in docs-16.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
